name: Jay Tiftickjian
tagline: Top rated DUI-DWI attorney in Denver, Colorado

about: Jay Tiftickjian, featured on the cover of Colorado Super Lawyers 2022, is widely recognized as one of Colorado’s leading DUI defense attorneys. He has been voted the best DUI lawyer in Colorado for over a decade, reflecting his outstanding reputation among peers and clients. He is the only attorney to have served as President of the Colorado Criminal Defense Bar and is a former Deputy District Attorney.

Mr. Tiftickjian is regularly invited to speak before attorneys and judges statewide, sharing his expertise on impaired driving defense. He has authored and co-authored numerous articles and publications on DUI defense trial strategies, including Colorado DUI Defense: The Law and Practice, Second Edition , the definitive work on the subject. As the founder of his eponymous law firm, he represents clients across Colorado from his office in Denver.

Mr. Tiftickjian has extensive experience handling a broad spectrum of DUI cases, from first-time offenses involving alcohol or drugs to second and third offenses, as well as felony DUI, vehicular assault, and homicide charges. His clients have benefited from his proficiency in litigating constitutional motions and jury trials, achieving dismissals and acquittals in both misdemeanor and felony cases. When appropriate, and with client consent, Mr. Tiftickjian has successfully negotiated favorable plea agreements that significantly reduce charges and penalties.
